Bare filename href (no URI scheme) renders as inline link, not autolink (#397)

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"foobar.png\">foobar.png</a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result)
```
